stages.title: Maximum wage and inequality
stages.sub: After this stage the student can explain why a maximum wage narrows the gap between top and bottom earners.

steps.q: A government worried about fairness sets a legal limit on how much a chief executive can be paid. What has happened to the very top pay in the firm?
steps.right: It is held down at a fixed limit
steps.hint: The law stops pay going above a certain point, so what can the top figure still do?
